# HeyDoot

> Manage WhatsApp Groups and Customer Communications at Scale for Modern Businesses without API Complexity.

HeyDoot (by HashStudioz Technologies) is an enterprise-grade WhatsApp CRM and multi-number shared inbox platform designed for customer support, sales, marketing, and operations teams. It enables businesses to connect multiple WhatsApp accounts into a unified team workspace, automate responses, assign tickets, manage groups, and integrate with external CRMs and ERP systems.

## Key Features

- **Multi-Number Shared Inbox**: Connect multiple WhatsApp numbers and assign conversations seamlessly across team members and departments.
- **Group Management & Automation**: Manage large-scale WhatsApp communities and groups with automated moderation, bulk actions, and member engagement workflows.
- **Ticketing & Task Assignment**: Convert incoming WhatsApp chats into manageable tickets, set priority levels, assign agents, and monitor resolution times.
- **AI & Rule-Based Automations**: Build intelligent auto-replies, conversational flows, keyword triggers, and 24/7 routing bots without writing complex code.
- **Enterprise-Grade Security**: 256-bit encryption, role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication, audit logs, and compliance readiness (GDPR/SOC2).
- **No Complex API Approval Required**: Get started instantly without cumbersome WhatsApp Cloud API verification bottlenecks.

## Integrations

HeyDoot integrates with thousands of business applications via webhooks, REST APIs, and native connectors:

- [HubSpot WhatsApp Integration](https://heydoot.com/integrations/hubspot.php): Sync WhatsApp leads, conversation histories, and automate deal stage messages inside HubSpot CRM.
- [Zapier & Make Automation](https://heydoot.com/integrations/zapier.php): Connect HeyDoot with 5000+ cloud apps to trigger WhatsApp notifications on external events.
- [Smoobu Vacation Rental Integration](https://heydoot.com/integrations/smoobu.php): Automate guest booking confirmations, check-in instructions, and reservation alerts for property managers.
- [Odoo ERP WhatsApp Integration](https://heydoot.com/integrations/odoo.php): Automate sales orders, PDF invoices, delivery tracking, and payment reminders directly from Odoo ERP.
- [Partner Integration & API Guide (v1)](https://heydoot.com/integrations/guide.php): Comprehensive REST API, webhook signatures, message dispatch, error handling, and security reference for developers and partners.
- [Integrations Directory](https://heydoot.com/integrations.php): Full catalog of available and supported third-party integrations.
